rules.textRegex: (UI Document was modified externally|UI (Document|文档).*(modified externally|外部.*修改))
rules.note: Reload the UI document after Unity reports that it was modified externally.

rules.textRegex: (changed on disk|modified externally|modified outside (of )?Unity|Reload Script Assemblies|scripts?.*(changed|modified).*(reload|recompile)|磁盘.*(更改|修改)|外部.*(更改|修改)|重新加载.*脚本|重载.*脚本)
rules.source: Unity asset refresh and domain reload workflow
rules.note: Prefer the externally updated project files used by the automated worker.

rules.buttonRegex: (I Made a Backup.*Go Ahead|Yes|Okay|OK|Update|Run API Updater|继续|确定|更新)
targetButtonNames: I Made a Backup. Go Ahead!
rules.targetButtonRegex: ^(I Made a Backup.*Go Ahead!?|Run API Updater|Update|Yes|Okay|OK|继续|更新|确定)$
rules.source: Unity API Updater documentation and Issue Tracker 888747
rules.note: The worker branch is version controlled, so allow Unity's API Updater to migrate obsolete APIs.

rules.titleRegex: (Enter Safe Mode\?|Safe Mode|Unity|进入安全模式)
rules.textRegex: (Enter Safe Mode|compilation errors.*Safe Mode|进入安全模式|编译错误.*安全模式)
rules.note: Ignore Safe Mode so project/package managed code, including the Unity Skill, can still load. Change this rule if the worker uses a different recovery policy.

rules.textRegex: (different version of Unity|older version of Unity|upgrade.*project|项目.*(不同|旧).*Unity.*版本|升级.*项目)
rules.note: Continue only when the configured worker intentionally opens this project with its installed Unity version.
